## LTX Video 2.3 Fast API

LTX Video 2.3 Fast is a text to video and image to video model by Lightricks, available on the Venice API as `ltx-2-v2-3-fast-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

### LTX Video 2.3 Fast API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ltx-2-v2-3-fast-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.0661 / sec |
| `ltx-2-v2-3-fast-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.0661 / sec |

Clip prices for `ltx-2-v2-3-fast-text-to-video`, silent:

| Duration | 1080p | 1440p | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per second | $0.0661 | $0.132 | $0.2639 |
| 6s | $0.40 | $0.79 | $1.58 |
| 10s | $0.66 | $1.32 | $2.64 |
| 20s | $1.32 | $2.64 | $5.28 |

Any length from 6 to 20 seconds in 2-second steps, priced per second.

### LTX Video 2.3 Fast specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Lightricks |
| Released | Mar 5, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Modes | text to video and image to video |
| Resolutions | 1080p, 1440p, 4K |
| Durations | 6s, 8s, 10s, 12s, 14s, 16s, 18s, 20s |
| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16 |
| Audio | Optional |

### How to use the LTX Video 2.3 Fast API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "ltx-2-v2-3-fast-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "ltx-2-v2-3-fast-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "6s",
    "resolution": "1080p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "audio": true
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "ltx-2-v2-3-fast-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
